question: True or false: Giorgio de Chirico denounced some of his own genuine early paintings as forgeries?
answer: True. In later life he disowned genuine canvases from his celebrated metaphysical years, sometimes out of spite towards their owners, while painting new versions of the same works and dating them to the 1910s. The market paid for early dates, and he could assign them. Scholars now accept many of the disowned pictures as genuine.
